title: Lumbra, which is developing tech to orchestrate AI agents in ultra-secure computing environments for the intelligence community, raised a $25M Series A (Mike Wheatley/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Mike Wheatley / SiliconANGLE: Lumbra, which is developing tech to orchestrate AI agents in ultra-secure computing environments for the intelligence community, raised a $25M Series A — When it comes to matters of national security, it's vitally important to ensure that the right intelligence gets to the right decision-makers …
